4.4.1 High Voltage System Safety Check - General
HayesX-250 utilizes a dual 108V DC electrical power system.
The front and rear battery packs are connected to the aircraft’s main power system through QS12 high-voltage connectors.
High-voltage system maintenance shall only be performed by trained personnel.
QS12 connectors undamaged and in good condition
Locking mechanism is normal and functional
Do not connect or disconnect QS12 connectors under electrical load.
Do not operate with damaged connectors.
If any of the following occurs:
Disconnect power immediately and discontinue operation.
